swing_ideas.text: Smaller timeframe inverted head and shoulders developing with a neckline at 121. Over that and there is a gap to close overhead. Mind the daily 200 and 50 SMAs (green and blue respectively). In play so long as 116.75 holds the right shoulder.

Really scraping the bottom of the barrel for this setup. It just hardly meets our criteria.

Hammers holding over the prior highs, but most importantly it is waking up out of a longer term weekly base. Check the multi year weekly chart for that. Holds of 4.6 keep longs in play, and over 5, the next target is at 5.7.

Retesting the base breakout zone after the earnings gap up. Huge hammer from Friday suggesting that buyers are willing to get involved over the 50 SMA (blue). Earnings gap up high would be the first target if this can get up and over 85.4. Out of play if it fails to hold the daily 50 SMA (blue).

Market internals – Not a huge amount of volume flowing out of the market on Friday, especially relative to the previous Friday's rally. The liquidation off of the open to end last week doesn't strike me as new money sellers for that reason. Other metrics objectively bearish.

Market profile – Value shifted lower on Friday, and we can see the poor low from F/G periods. Note that the Tuesday half day poor high was repaired in RTH session of Thursday. Value needs to get over Friday high (6050 area) if buyers have a shot at keeping control.
